name: Hwarang
headerMeta: Golden era · Ranged infantry · special · 295 leadership · Seasonal (Silla: Hwarang's Oath)
pitch: A stacking ranged DPS unit that unlocks advanced abilities at 40 kills (unit or hero), then deletes at range with Arrow Rain and Artemis. Its weakness is the pre-stack grind and vulnerability to early pressure.

doctrines.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
doctrines.note: Arrow Rain deals 75% base piercing per hit, +150 piercing DMG; shoot anywhere with increased range, aim-bots closest target

doctrines.name: Precision Doctrine V
doctrines.note: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire

doctrines.name: Artemis
doctrines.note: unit-unique: Double Strings — fires 2 arrows per shot for 12s, 40s CD; can't combine with other actives except Overwatch

doctrines.name: Epic Leadership Doctrine
doctrines.note: only unit in the game where Leadership outvalues Unit DMG V

doctrines.name: Whistling Arrow Doctrine V
doctrines.note: alt for Artemis: every 3 hits inflict bleeding for 12% current health; GREAT in duo-Hwarang — replace Artemis on at least one unit to compound bleed across both

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: Skirmish focus; Relentless Advancing capstone renames the unit.

battleRole.positioning: Blob formation once stacked (40 unit kills or 8 hero kills, or a mix). Reposition with Skill 2 to dodge threats. {1}
battleRole.tips: Normal combo: 1 → Arrow Rain → V+Artemis → 1 (wait for each step to end). Artemis and Arrow Rain do NOT stack. Arrow Rain: 160 meter range, 14s duration. Spell 1: 7s duration. Can play without Artemis and skip that step. {1}

controls.notes: Stack first (40 unit kills or 8 hero kills, or a mix; stacks even when unit isn't deployed) to unlock advanced abilities. {1} Skill 1 ignores most shields and does insane DMG. Skill 2 repositions and dodges threats. {1} Arrow Rain is MANDATORY — normal V is really bad on Hwarang; Arrow Rain lets you shoot anywhere with increased range, aim-bots closest target in the circle. {1}
